title: How to Use
items:
[b][size=4]How to Use[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] Load into a save with squad portraits visible.
[*] Downed and injury states will appear as portrait icons and optional text badges automatically.
[*] Adjust [u]mod-config.json[/u] if you want different text/icon visibility, size, corners, margins, or textures.
[*] If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/kenshi/mods/1885]Emkejs-Mod-Core[/url] is installed, you can adjust the main overlay settings from Mod Hub in game.
[/list]
